actions.name: hop_forward
actions.prompt: Dorowani hops forward twice with springy knees, landing planted and alert, red fin cheeks flaring with each landing

actions.name: water_orb
actions.prompt: Dorowani raises both hands and charges a Water Orb - a sphere of swirling blue water growing and spinning between its palms, droplets orbiting it - then pushes both hands forward and launches the orb ahead in a rushing arc of water

actions.name: startled_flinch
actions.prompt: Dorowani flinches back with a startled hop, red fin cheeks flaring wide, arms thrown up, then settles into a wary crouch staring at what scared it

actions.name: offer_berry
actions.prompt: Dorowani holds out a small berry in one open palm toward a friend beside it, leaning in eagerly, tail shell wobbling, waiting for them to take it

dorowani.canon: Blue bipedal creature, red fin cheeks, red eyes, light belly, dorsal fin, tan shell on its back. Signature move: Water Orb.

actions.name: heavy_trundle
actions.prompt: Gabu trundles forward with heavy, deliberate steps, low body swaying side to side, dust puffing softly at each stomp

actions.name: tremor
actions.prompt: Gabu rears up and slams both front feet down, performing Tremor - the ground cracks and ripples outward in a ring, pebbles bouncing, a low shockwave rolling away from its feet

actions.name: startled_rumble
actions.prompt: Gabu startles with a whole-body jolt, tucking its head down as a deep rumble shakes loose dust from its back, then peers out suspiciously

actions.name: nudge_friend
actions.prompt: Gabu gently nudges a much smaller friend with the side of its broad head, careful and slow, then rumbles happily when the friend pats it back

gabu.canon: Signature move: Tremor (new move; game-data stats are owner-set and are NOT invented here - this entry covers performance only).

actions.name: prowl_dash
actions.prompt: Kittember prowls low for two steps then breaks into a quick dash, flame markings along its body flickering brighter as it speeds up

actions.name: fire_stream
actions.prompt: Kittember plants its feet, chest swelling with heat, and breathes Fire Stream - a focused jet of orange flame streaming forward in a roaring ribbon

actions.name: embarrassed_sizzle
actions.prompt: Kittember freezes mid-step, ears flat, its flame markings sputtering down to embarrassed little sparks, then shakes its whole body to relight them

actions.name: warm_a_friend
actions.prompt: Kittember curls around a shivering friend, flame markings glowing warm and steady like a campfire, tail tip flickering gently

kittember.canon: Signature move: Fire Stream (already an original name in canon).

actions.name: bounce_travel
actions.prompt: Mochii travels by bouncing in springy hops, squashing flat on each landing and stretching tall at the top of each bounce, giggling expression the whole way

actions.name: hydro_rush
actions.prompt: Mochii crouches, water swirling around its feet, then performs Hydro Rush - bursting forward in a spiralling jet of water, trailing foam and droplets

actions.name: surprised_squash
actions.prompt: Mochii gasps and squashes flat in surprise, eyes wide, then slowly reinflates back to its round shape with a relieved wobble

actions.name: share_a_splash
actions.prompt: Mochii scoops up water in both hands and offers it to a friend, splashing a little on its own face by accident and laughing

mochii.canon: Signature move: Hydro Rush (canon Mochiichao name for the move keyed AQUA_JET; internal id unchanged).

actions.name: waddle_scurry
actions.prompt: Sproutle scurries forward on short legs in a leafy waddle, the sprout on its head bobbing with every step, nearly tipping at each turn

actions.name: leaf_blast
actions.prompt: Sproutle shakes its head hard and performs Leaf Blast - a burst of sharp green leaves blasting forward from its sprout in a swirling volley

actions.name: near_tip_wobble
actions.prompt: Sproutle wobbles to the very edge of tipping over, arms windmilling, sprout spinning, then catches its balance and stands proud and dizzy

actions.name: shade_a_friend
actions.prompt: Sproutle shuffles beside a tired friend and leans so the leaves of its sprout shade the friend's face, fanning them slowly

sproutle.canon: Small sprout creature. Signature move: Leaf Blast (canon Mochiichao name for the move keyed RAZOR_LEAF; internal id unchanged).

actions.name: drift_across
actions.prompt: Wispkin drifts slowly across the frame, bobbing gently on its smoky black trail, tilting its cracked white skull mask side to side as if listening to something far away

actions.name: dark_wave
actions.prompt: Wispkin rears back, gathers swirling dark purple-black energy around its small hands, then throws both hands forward and releases Dark Wave - a rippling wave of dark energy rolling out in front of it

actions.name: mask_crack_flinch
actions.prompt: Wispkin flinches and clutches both three-fingered hands over its cracked white skull mask, smoke trail curling tight, then slowly peeks out through its fingers

actions.name: haunt_a_friend_playfully
actions.prompt: Wispkin sneaks up behind a friend, rises up tall on its smoke trail with arms spread in a playful haunt pose, then collapses into silent giggling wobbles when the friend turns around

wispkin.canon: Small black round plush-like character, cracked white skull mask, large glossy black eyes, pointed black hood, three-fingered black hands, smoky black trail instead of legs. Signature move: Dark Wave (canon Mochiichao name for the move keyed SHADOW_PULSE; internal id unchanged).

notes: Every entry is FREE-TEXT performance wording for the I2V prompt field - there are no slot names in the freedom path. This library is a proven-wording starting point, not a limit: job_format_v2.md accepts any action Jamar describes.

Signature names follow canon: Hydro Rush (Mochii), Water Orb (Dorowani), Tremor (Gabu), Fire Stream (Kittember), Leaf Blast (Sproutle), Dark Wave (Wispkin). Water Orb and Tremor are new moves whose game-data entries wait on owner-set stats - nothing here invents stats; these entries cover performance only.
Prompts assume the wired pipeline: the character starts from its canon cutout on a pure white field (prep_start_frame.py), so prompts describe the performance only - no background, no camera moves.

shared_style_block.negative_prompt: 3d render, cgi, pixar, photorealistic, realistic, blurry, distorted, deformed, morphing, changing design, extra characters, extra limbs, text, watermark, logo, camera movement, zoom, background change, colored background
shared_style_block.negative_source: Verbatim DEFAULT_NEG from run_backend.py (ep01-rebuild/animation-backend/run_backend.py) - the same negative block the wired Kaggle backend sends today.
shared_style_block.style_prefix: flat 2D cartoon animation, clean cel shading, bold outlines, solid colors, the character performing on a pure white background, locked-off camera
shared_style_block.usage: Prepend style_prefix to the segment's action text for the positive prompt; send negative_prompt as the job's negative field, exactly as run_backend.py does.
